label: Chess960
hint: Pieces on the back rank are shuffled; castling still works.

label: King of the Hill
hint: Win by bringing your king to one of the four centre squares.

label: Three-check
hint: Win by giving check three times.

label: Antichess
hint: Captures are forced; lose all your pieces to win.

label: Atomic
hint: Captures explode, removing every piece next to them except pawns.

label: Horde
hint: White has 36 pawns and must checkmate; Black must capture them all.

label: Racing Kings
hint: No checks allowed; the first king to reach the eighth rank wins.
